# Chess rules

`chess.js` is the unmodified ES-module distribution of chess.js 1.4.0
(`node_modules/chess.js/dist/esm/chess.js`).
The upstream BSD-2-Clause license is included as `chess.LICENSE`.

This local copy lets the vanilla browser app run without a CDN, bundler,
or access to `node_modules` in the static publish. When updating the npm
dependency, replace this copy and its license together and run the game tests.
